qualifier: presynapse organization and synaptic protein localization
name: Regulation of synapse assembly and presynapse organization
rationale: All members are positive or negative regulators of synapse formation and presynaptic organization; unlike the confusables they contain no specific adhesion-molecule, receptor-clustering or postsynaptic density assembly terms.

qualifier: Na+/K+ pump gradient and paracellular tight-junction transport
name: Na+/K+ pump gradient and paracellular magnesium homeostasis
rationale: Members cover P-type ATPase-driven Na+/K+ gradients (including glycoside response), Na+/K+/Mg2+ homeostasis and claudin tight-junction paracellular transport, whereas confusables centre on chloride cotransporters, potassium channels or vasopressin water handling.

name: RB-E2F and CDK control of G1/S transition
rationale: All members concern G1/S control via cyclin D/CDK4/6, cyclin E/CDK2, p27/p21 degradation and RB/DREAM repression of E2F targets, distinct from confusables focused on DNA replication origin licensing or G2/M.

qualifier: adrenal and gonadal steroidogenic enzymes and their defects
name: Adrenal and gonadal steroidogenesis and its enzyme defects
rationale: Members span corticosteroid, androgen, estrogen and progestin synthesis, its regulation and steroidogenic CYP enzyme deficiencies, while confusables concern vitamin D/retinoid CYPs or glucocorticoid secretion and response.

core: Glycine and proline transport across the plasma membrane
qualifier: imino acid transporters defective in iminoglycinuria
name: Glycine and proline transport and iminoglycinuria
rationale: Members concern plasma membrane uptake of glycine and proline by proton-coupled and SLC6 transporters whose variants cause iminoglycinuria/hyperglycinuria, unlike confusables on cationic, cystine or Hartnup-type amino acid transport.

core: Regulation of sequestered calcium release and cytosolic calcium
qualifier: ryanodine receptor release and Na+/Ca2+ exchange clearance
name: Ryanodine-receptor calcium release and Na+/Ca2+ exchange clearance
rationale: Members regulate release of ER/SR calcium through ryanodine-sensitive channels (including in skeletal muscle) and lowering of cytosolic calcium by Na+/Ca2+ exchangers, lacking the cardiac, SERCA-pump and store-operated entry terms of confusables.

core: Synaptic vesicle and neurotransmitter receptor trafficking
name: Rab/ARF-regulated synaptic vesicle and receptor trafficking
rationale: Members cover presynaptic vesicle cycle and active zone maintenance plus postsynaptic receptor endosomal trafficking, together with Rab/ARF signaling and RabGAPs, whereas confusables emphasize clathrin-mediated endocytosis or dendrite and AMPA receptor terms.

name: Collagen degradation by matrix metalloproteinases
rationale: All three members concern collagen catabolism and MMP activation, distinct from confusables on fibrinolysis or extracellular matrix assembly and integrin interactions.

name: Secretory pathway and endosome-Golgi membrane trafficking
rationale: Members span ER protein targeting and export, COPI/COPII and intra-Golgi traffic, Golgi organization, Rab/ARF regulation and endosome-Golgi-lysosome sorting, unlike confusables on autophagy/ESCRT, mitophagy, the unfolded protein response or connexin assembly.

name: Dopamine receptor signaling and psychostimulant behavioural responses
rationale: Members combine D1/D2-type dopamine receptor signaling, DARPP-32 and opioid signaling with cocaine, amphetamine and nicotine responses and reward learning, distinct from confusables on ethanol or social behaviours, neuropeptides and dopamine synthesis/transport.

qualifier: NADPH regeneration, ascorbate and aldehyde detoxification
name: Redox homeostasis via NADPH, ascorbate and aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members cover ROS detoxification, NADPH/NADP+ supply, ascorbate and tetrahydrobiopterin metabolism, methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and protein repair, rather than the glutathione, ferroptosis-promoting or DNA alkylation repair terms of confusables.

name: CaMK-dependent CREB activation in synapse-to-nucleus signaling
rationale: Members describe CaMKII/CaMKK/CaMKIV phosphorylation of CREB, NPAS4 induction and postsynapse-to-nucleus signaling for long-term memory, distinct from confusables on cAMP/PKA-driven CREB activation or MECP2.

name: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation and promoter escape
rationale: All members cover Pol II pre-initiation complex formation, promoter opening and escape, unlike confusables on elongation, pausing, HIV elongation or nucleotide excision repair.

qualifier: cranial and peripheral nerves and specific neuron types
name: Cranial and peripheral nerve development and axon guidance
rationale: Members concern cranial, sensory and sympathetic nerve development, axon guidance of defined neuron types and neuronal migration, without the hindbrain patterning or semaphorin/netrin signaling terms of confusables.

name: TLR-triggered TAK1/IKK activation of canonical NF-kappaB
rationale: Members describe IRAK/TRAF6/TRIF/RIP1-mediated TAK1 and IKK complex activation downstream of Toll-like receptors leading to canonical NF-kappaB, distinct from noncanonical NF-kappaB and TBK1-IRF3/7 confusables.

core: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability and translation
name: 3'-UTR binding protein control of mRNA stability and translation
rationale: Members are AU-rich and 3'-UTR binding proteins (AUF1, TTP, BRF1, KSRP, HuR, IGF2BPs, L13a) that stabilize, destabilize or silence mRNAs, unlike confusables on stress granules, decapping or miRNA silencing.
